title: Songbook and Summer
author: I. M. Halloran
blurb: Odile Galloway, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
